nom: RoC Derm Correxion Firming Serum Stick

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: some report no irritation, redness, or sensitivity even with daily or twice-daily use, while one reports the product burned her face and neck and caused lasting redness and irritation.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s, 60s, and 70s report firmer, smoother-looking skin on the neck, jawline, and hands, though several say improvement is modest or still uncertain after only a few weeks.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers describe visible improvement in fine lines, wrinkles, neck sagging, jowls, and hand wrinkles, often within one to two weeks; a few report no change at all after a month or more of consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say the product leaves skin hydrated, plump, and glowing, especially on the neck and hands; one reviewer instead found it drying.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the product burned her skin and left her face and neck red and irritated for days after a possible formula change.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer felt the stick created a barrier that prevented her moisturizer from absorbing properly afterward.
concerns.spots: One long-time user asks about a companion product for brown spots but does not report results for this stick specifically on spots.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer says the product caused breakouts when used on her face and switched to using it only on neck and chest; another states it did not cause breakouts for her.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers describe the formula as hydrating without being greasy, though a few found it tacky or sticky on application.

aspects.libelle: Packaging peels or paint flakes off
Applicator mechanism fails or dries out

extraits.texte: I have used this for quite awhile. I have bought 3 or 4 of them and loved what it did for my face. Yes it's greasy but it works while you sleep so not a problem. Until the last one I bought burned my face and neck... Did you change the formula Roc? I haven't used it for 3 days and my face and neck are still red and my neck is very irritated. Now I can't put anything on my face!

I have very sensitive skin.. However I can use this multiple times daily with zero side effects. Sounds like a great problem right ? But I question how it can contain effective retinol when it doesn't seem to do anything to my skin.

extraits.titre: Easy application on neck and chest
extraits.texte: Unable to use on my face as it caused breakouts, but I continue to use it on my neck and chest, and feel it has improved my skin.

I have looked and searched high and low for a retinol product that won't fry my sensitive skin. This product, in my experience thus far, has been just that. When I use it consistently my acne and neckline improve greatly. Would highly recommend to someone who has a skincare routine that they want to add too.

This retinol stick has earned permanent status in my routine. Solid stick format is clean, simple, and precise Designed for the neck, but works well on hands too Gentle enough for sensitive skin Not sticky and layers easily with other products I originally bought this based on dermatologist recommendations, and it fully lives up to the hype. It's effective without being harsh, which is exactly what I want for the neck and chest area. I also love that it's ideal for travel — no leaking, no stability concerns, and no awkward containers. I've been through several of these, and always keep one on hand. Reliable, smart skincare done well.

extraits.titre: Easy skin care that works for aging skin
extraits.texte: I actually can't believe how good this is. I have been using for almost a year and my skin is so much smoother and healthy. I am over 50, but I think it has de-aged my skin. The stick lasts a long time. I use it on my face, neck, and back of hands. If I were to tell someone to get only one product, this would be it

extraits.titre: Visible improvement in the first two weeks
extraits.texte: I am impressed with this product! Not only is application easy with the roll-on packaging, wrinkles showed definite improvement in the first two weeks of use. I use it once daily, and though it can be used morning and evening, I've kept it to once a day because I've had reactions to retinol products in the past, and there was still definite improvement to face wrinkles.
